decisions.text: Empty required number inputs (params, cost C/N, copies, pool and threshold values) store 0 rather than leaving the field undefined.
Empty optional numeric fields (trophicLevel, o2Produced, o2PerRound, lifespan) and empty subtype and canEat remove the key from the card instead of storing undefined or an empty string.
Comma-list inputs keep local draft text and commit parsed lists on each change, re-syncing only when the stored list changes from outside, so typing a comma is not swallowed.
Export file name replaces characters invalid in file names with '-' and falls back to 'ruleset'.
Storage availability is probed once on mount with a test write and remove in try/catch.
Interpretations screen adds a one-line intro paragraph above the sections.

gaps: No component-level behavioral tests were added: the repo has no jsdom or Testing Library setup, and the frozen-test list for this lane is empty. Acceptance behaviors (number edit changes only one field, export-then-import round trip, bad import keeps ruleset) are verified by code reading and the orchestrator smoke run, not by an automated test.
No browser interaction run was done (no clicks on Export/Import/Reset); only HTTP serving of the dev server was checked.
Card id is not shown or editable in the table (not in the spec column list); renaming ids is therefore not possible from the editor.
Alley graph impact was run for both owned files before editing; context preview printed no lessons.

questions.text: Should the card id be shown read-only in the editor table? It is not in the spec column list, so it was left out; renaming ids would drop abilities.
